metadata.title: URUSHI — Layers of Lacquer
metadata.name: URUSHI
metadata.descriptionEn: One original lacquer vessel, eleven chapters through wood, coating, humid curing, abrasion, layers, polish and maki-e.
metadata.descriptionZh: 沿同一只原创漆盒，走过木胎、薄涂、湿度固化、研磨、层积、抛光与莳绘的十一章材质旅程。
metadata.worldEn: Lacquer / material / time and reflected light
metadata.worldZh: 漆艺 / 材料 / 光与时间
metadata.socialAlt: URUSHI's original procedural lacquer vessel captured from its actual material journey
metadata.rendering: One persistent original procedural vessel and authored GLSL material; original renderer-captured stills preserve every chapter when WebGL is unavailable.
metadata.imageOrigin: Runtime and fallback images are original procedural renders. Thirteen supplied AI-generated images remain visual research with their original prompts, rather than runtime plates.
metadata.clock: One original requestAnimationFrame owner; one Lenis instance, lerp 0.105, native touch, no autoRaf and no second scene easing

capture.origin: Actual opening composition of the supplied original procedural LacquerRenderer. No AI image, museum photograph or redraw was used.

review.graph: MCP graph transport closed and new source unindexed; actual source fallback used, no successful graph claim.
review.securityAndLicenses: Independent source audit passed 14 supplied read-only checks and 116 manifest checks. Scoped MIT original code/model/texture/stills; Latin and renamed CJK OFL; generated visual Bible references identified separately. Only local assets, optional language/motion storage and eight reader-opened HTTPS research links. No telemetry/upload/eval.
review.preaudit: Independent original production UI 176/176 checks across 11 chapters, EN/ZH, reduced and still editions, mid material states, six sizes, controls and context loss/restore; 100 captures independently viewed.
review.integration: Scoped dev main final matrix 108/108 checks, 48 captures, no page errors. Supplemental 22 mid-chapter and two early-input checks passed. Final native anchor/visible-exit/resize regression 12/12; independent stable-source no-HMR fresh cold and actual arbitrary wheel/reload acceptance 7/7 (three fresh navigate .16 opacity1 and four reload exact Y retained). Arbitrary refresh, native dialogs, range keyboard, replay, resize, reverse input, reduced/fallback all chapters, noJS/native return, late-ready pose and six-size composition exercised; current ACCEPTANCE separates dev harness limits and outstanding root production gates.
collectionChanges: Original single RAF and one Lenis .105 with native touch/reduced input
Resize queued on original clock and no second scene ease
Measured scene scroll margins give native fragments and authored navigation the same stable .16 landing; native reload/history positions retained
Native visible Collection/noJS navigation, shared visible exit stylesheet and HTML-owned CSS
Original Latin font bytes extracted as standalone assets; no dependency/package/build changes
review.production: Main task: 187 model tests, root/project-path production builds and 728-reference verifications, 52 normal desktop/phone entries across 26 works. Genuine same-window tab hidden/resume and BFCache pageshow.persisted true with URUSHI 1200px-to-1200px restoration passed. Independent URUSHI production five batches executed 187 raw assertions: 181 passed and six original fixed-delay failures remain recorded, closed by strict settled rechecks8/8 without runtime change or weaker tolerance. Two reduced fresh cold links passed; final rebuilt no-JavaScript D/M4/4 independent assertions plus2/2 scoped native text-exit flows passed (17px text164px, real Collection clicks).29fresh contexts119fullframes, complete contacts and selected full-resolution frames visually reviewed. No unresolved confirmed production defect. Main source SHA6a3973d6484d09cc203f2b9e36f8ea553f91b98a74f41f8f5f7ac994fbad2b3b. See final ACCEPTANCE and external urushi-upstream/production/report.md+summary.json.
limitations: No FPS/power or prolonged memory-soak certification
Headless dev minimization and Vite Back harness preconditions were not satisfied; separate genuine production native lifecycle acceptance passed
Exact deployed asset identity/live flows remain a subsequent root release gate
